content.label: Can’t say enough good things - one of the best value purchases I ever made. Simple, no adds, tracks what I want to track, and eliminates excuses.

Streaks is fantastic! It’s very clean, easily customizable, and allows for tracking positive and negative habits in a variety of ways. 

Plus, you aren’t locked into an inappropriate subscription for life!

Get this app and support the creators. It’s worth it.
I LOVE that this now ties into health goals automatically. I found myself walking around the block at 11 PM to keep my streak alive.
This app is amazing! The core interaction and UI is simple, but it's customizable in every way I can think of. This is the best habits app I've used, and it syncs between MacOS and iOS.

I’m incredibly pleased with how this app as helped me maintain several healthy habits I’ve struggled with for years.

A request for the developer: can you add a feature whereby we can assign a threshold for a “reward” to be triggered, which we can custom define and describe? For example, if I wanted to reward myself after a streak with a fun purchase, I could add this to the task: if this task reaches X concurrent completions, then this “reward” message will show… also, it’d be great to be able to trigger from non-sequential completions too. Those are easier to lose track of, and more likely to be a pleasant surprise when the reward message triggers.

Streaks is the best habit tracker I’ve used. I particularly appreciate the strong, clean, functional design and intuitive UI. It is thoughtfully minimal in the best way. I would love to see a widget that showed weekly completion stats for all tasks at a glance (several trackers offer this now, basically a table with days of week as columns and tasks as rows, with dots showing days of completion).

It’ll do for now. I want to really give it a few weeks at least before I make a decision to stick with it or not.

The interface is clunky and difficult to navigate, but the visual appearance is not so bad. In other words, the UX is uncomfortable. 

Only 24 habits? And only 6 per page? This design seems arbitrary and limiting. Designing and creating a new habit also feels confusing and limiting. I am hoping that either I get used to it, or the health app integration will make it worth it, otherwise I’ll try other apps.

I have certain tasks/goals/habits that are daily, some weekly, some bi-weekly.  As far as I can tell this app does not have a view that shows only the tasks that are due today.  Nor can the tasks be displayed on just one screen.  There are multiple screens to scroll through.  There's a lot about this app to like, but there's no ability to simply look at the screen and see clearly what is due today - for my purposes it makes the app almost useless.
Amazing app, it’s so much fun to use every day and really helps to keep me on track

title.label: awesome tool to stay on track

but they really should let you put as many habits as you want.  Regardless still the best.  I have tried them all. Wayoflife, habitify, strides, I am sure like 200 others in my time tracking habits

Dynamic island time is totally broken. Island and in app timer not in sync.
it's okay, wish I could see a single view of all the tasks though, and wish I could stack them in a routine

title.label: Everything you need, nothing you don’t

content.label: I have had this app for many many years, and I don’t think there is anything more satisfying than seeing the circles turn gold. It is simple, encouraging, and doesn’t overstimulate the way other similar apps do. The integrations with apple health and other apps reduce the mental load even further of getting things logged. A rare app that genuinely makes my life a little better.

This  app is amazing. I’m 12 years old and have tons of homework each night, and this makes it so easy to keep track of all of it. I hope everyone has experience with this much help in organizing the tasks! A 10 out of 10 must get!!

I LIVE FOR YOU STREAKS😭😭😍
Best habit tracker. Period.  And I’ve tried dozens.

This is truly a great app. I liked how the devolopers haven’t made it into a subscription business like most of the other habit tracking apps. I found the interface and usability even better than the other habit trackers. The big circles for each habit and long press to complete the habit is a nice touch, since it assures we dont accidently click and mark it as complete.

Now, after using this tracker daily for quite few weeks, here is what I would love to have. If they can put an optional textbox in the notifications which is for what we would like to be displayed on the phone screen for that notification - this would be great. 

Here is my why,
I have this habit - Take medicines. I really loved how we can set multiple notifications for a habit. But if I can see what medication to take when that notification comes in my phone screen, then it would be helpful. For eg, a notification at 9:00 am, says ‘take allergy meds’. Another notification at 12:00 pm says ‘take multivitamins’. 

I know this is not a todo tracker and I certainly dont want it to become one. So give it a thought and bring it only if you guys think this would be helpful in habit tracking, and if you think this would go more towards the todo tracker then you can ignore my request.

While it does allow sharing a task for others, it doesn’t do much to encourage that person to notice your progress or provide an easy way for them to provide encouragement. Overall, this app has had a minimal impact on my efforts so far. You should study how Apple engages people with its fitness rings, which are much more engaging and collaborative (Side note… a faq said I should subscribe to iCloud to fix the syncing problem. It didn’t.) For an app I paid for, I’m disappointed. I hope it gets better. If it does, I’ll update my review.
Streaks is awesome!
My advice: start small. Both with the abit you want and the number of habits. You will become the person you desire to be.

Worthless

This app needs a major UX overall. It’s very difficult to set up. I’ve been fiddling with this for over an hour and still have not figured out how to see the widgets, Lock Screen stats, or other features they advertise. The tutorial is useless. This is the definition of not user friendly.
Hard to figure out how the use this app. I have two days of completing my tasks and have no streaks??

I’ve been using Streaks for months, despite all the friction that the app creates (unable to edit task completions for the past days, no undo, etc.).
But today, it got worse: Streaks just lost all my data. There’s ONE thing that such an app cannot do: lose data. That’s because sync just does not work in Streaks. When syncing, the app seems to take the task configuration from the last device that is synced. I had added a bunch of tasks on my iPhone and had tracked them for weeks. Then today when I tried to sync Streaks on my iPad, which I hadn’t synced in a while, it erased all the tasks that I had tracked on my iPhone. It’s all gone.
I just deleted this app from all my devices. If I can’t trust this app to preserve my data, it’s useless to me.

This habit building app is very simple and allows you to physically check off when you’ve accomplished a goal.  It is somewhat limited in its simplicity in terms of the types and goal planning it’s capable of tracking. Simple, cleanly designed, easy to use but not very sophisticated.
I love streaks. It is one of the best apps I have used for creating habits and reminding me what to do each day. It is very easy to use nice clean in her face. I recommend this to everyone. Joey D
I am in love with this app.

This is really not helpful! I wasted a lot of time setting it up and it doesn’t do any good for me. All it measures is stupid completions. I need to see progress I’m doing every day towards my goal. You spent more time choosing freaking colours to your backgrounds than learning what your customers really need. Deleted.
Th is app is so helpful to schedule my day and make sure I have crossed off everything from my list to/do list. It even offers you to ability to add in individual goals per person.

The streaks app gives you a bean counter to reward you for doing those little habits you would like to do. You can record notes. You can stack tasks onto a page and you get rewarded for completing everything by having all the medallions turn gold. It’s a simple and intuitive app and I think it’s perfect for tracking habits.

This has made such a difference in my life by helping me to begin and maintain good habits.  There is something so motivating about not wanting to “break my streak”!  Even my husband and daughter will encourage me to “set up a streak” when I mention I’m struggling to be consistent in an area of life.  They have seen the power of the streak to motivate me!  My first streak was to drink the appropriate number of glasses of water a day.   I am well over a 1000 days of not missing this goal….all because I don’t want to break my streak!!
It’s very easy to set up and unlike many other habit tracking apps, very customizable.
It's a great idea for an app, and it works. Plus, it's gorgeous.

title.label: Best to-do approach for building habits

content.label: I am a psychologist and I have worked with a lot of people who want to improve their organizational skills and executive functions (particularly those with ADHD) and I have recommended a lot of to do list type programs to people who have mixed success. This program is different. It helps you focus on a small amount of recurring tasks (it’s not for reminding you to send your aunt a thank you card). It is simple and rewarding to use, particularly with Apple Watch. The ability to customize the icons is fun and makes the tasks feel more like they are part of you. The tasks can be as flexible as you need them to be. Need to do it only once a month? You can set it up that way. I also like the timers you can put on task. Want to clean for 15 minutes a day? You can set it up like that. Very nicely made. Well worth the one time fee.

Initially I didn’t like the app because it showed the a notification number on the app and it stressed me out. But then I learned how to turn that number off! After fiddling around with the app, I realized just how dynamic and intricate this app is! Such a great execution to a great idea. Definitely worth the money—you’re paying for quality

title.label: An iPhone app masquerading as a macOS app

content.label: Don't bother if you want something for macOS, this is a repackaged iPhone app.

I kind of wish it had more features like a point system or something that rewarded you for keeping good habits, and then like a store or something where you could use your points. Other than the somewhat oversimplicity, it is a good app.

title.label: Great, but I miss the interactive Today Screen widget

content.label:
This is a great, well-organized, user-friendly app if you want to track your habits or tasks. However, for some reason, the interactive Today Screen widget (for iOS, at least) was removed a few months ago. The main purpose of this review is to BEGGGG for that feature to be reinstated!!! 

It was a HUGE game changer to be able to complete tasks without even having to open the app (pressing on a task within the widget would allow you to mark that task as complete). Now, the current widget options only allow you to see task progress; you cannot actually interact with the widget (pressing the widget will only open the app). 

PLEASE please please, if any of the app developers are reading this, will you add the interactive widget back!!! 🙏🙏🙏 I know this is a small, almost nit-picky request, but it has *completely* changed the experience and efficacy of the app for myself and, I am sure, many others. I honestly can’t think of any reason for that feature to have been removed, but I would absolutely love to have it back!!!!

Great app. Not overly bloated like other task/habit builder apps have become. My ONLY issue is the 24 max habits you can track. It would be nice to be able to track more. But that aside works well and easy to use and that one issue doesn’t diminish its rating.
Not intuitive
Excelente loving everything about this !

LOVE Streaks - so motivating, and the user interface is simple and easy to use. The “recommended” tasks are excellent when trying to think of things to include - but I am SO pleased with how easy it is to customize tasks to your personal lifestyle. Love the integration with Apple Health too!
